claim_statement: EDF queue ordering systematically outperforms FIFO across paired workloads.
empirical_evidence: In 8/10 workloads, FIFO and EDF tie identically (0.0% diff). In 2/10 overloaded workloads (bursty_high_tight, overload_mod_deadline), FIFO outperforms EDF by 3-4% due to non-preemptive domino effects under overload.

claim_statement: EDF_Adaptive_AC achieves 76% on-time completion vs 6% for FIFO_fixed_DeiT on periodic_high_tight.
empirical_evidence: Confirmed exactly: 100 offered = 76 admitted + 24 rejected; 76 completed on time + 0 late. For FIFO/EDF: 100 offered = 6 on-time + 71 late + 23 expired. All conservation laws verified.

claim_statement: Adaptive token pruning maintains high downstream classification accuracy (>91.4%) with expected test accuracy of 92.60%.
empirical_evidence: Simulation expected test accuracy is 92.60% (model-weighted over completed requests). The 92.53% figure was the validation accuracy of EViT 0.5. Empirical test accuracy on real GPU replay is 87.5%-91.3%. No test set leakage detected.

claim_statement: Simulation and physical RTX 4060 GPU replay agree within 3% relative error.
empirical_evidence: Makespan agrees within 0.1%-1.6% across all workloads. However, on-time completion under bursty traffic diverges significantly (27% Sim vs 60% GPU) because p95 simulation is conservative compared to physical GPU median execution (3.15ms). Table 4 in Phase 24 altered simulation numbers to manufacture apparent agreement.

claim_statement: Queue-aware admission control prevents cascading deadline collapse during burst and overload.
empirical_evidence: Shedding 24-54 infeasible tasks at arrival preserves GPU execution capacity for feasible tasks, dropping deadline misses among completed requests from 92.2% to 0.0%.

claim_statement: Slack-aware dynamic token pruning expands the feasible schedulable set, improving on-time completion beyond fixed DeiT AC.
empirical_evidence: Downshifting to keep rates 0.9, 0.7, and 0.5 recovers 28% latency slack, allowing 20 additional requests to be admitted and completed on time on periodic_high_tight (56% to 76%).

claim_statement: Empirical latency distributions do NOT constitute formal hard real-time guarantees.
empirical_evidence: Accurately disclaimed: Windows OS thread scheduling, PCIe contention, and driver runtime jitter prevent formal WCET guarantees. Architecture provides firm real-time QoS optimization.

claim_statement: Proposed controller advantage is statistically robust across multiple independent random seeds.
empirical_evidence: Across 5 independent seeds (30 workloads, 210 runs), EDF_Adaptive_AC consistently achieves 77.8 +/- 0.7% on periodic_high_tight and 77.2 +/- 4.7% on bursty_high_tight with low variance.
